All Hai Van vehicles have free high-speed Wi-Fi. Relax by browsing the web, catching up on social media, checking email or chatting with friends.

Seating

Entertainment

Cold towels and drinking water

Every passenger receives a free cold towel and drinking water on board.

USB charging ports & reading lights

We know modern travellers can't be without their smartphones. Rest assured, every vehicle has a phone charging port within easy reach of your seat.

Air conditioning & massage seats

All Hai Van vehicles have air conditioning that you can easily adjust to your liking. Our premium vehicles also feature massage seats, for a spa-like sense of relaxation.

Luggage space

Spacious luggage areas keep your suitcase and hand luggage safe. Don't forget to collect a luggage tag from our friendly drivers when you store bags at the back of the vehicle or in the hold.

dich-vu/xe-lien-tinh/hanh-ly.content:
Every one of our vehicles has space for your luggage. To keep your journey as comfortable and safe as possible, please read the following points of our luggage policy.

When you travel with us, you can bring free of charge:

- One piece of hand luggage (max. 42 x 30 x 18 cm, max. 15 kg)

- One small bag for personal items, such as a backpack, handbag, clothes bag, gift bag, laptop bag or camera bag

For safety reasons, please store your hand luggage in the locker at your seat so that emergency exits stay clear. Please make sure all your luggage is labelled with your name and address to avoid mix-ups. Our friendly drivers will be happy to help you load your bags into the luggage compartments.

Extra luggage

Extra luggage must not exceed the size and weight of standard travel luggage, and an additional fee applies if you go over the luggage allowance. You can add extra luggage by phone after booking by calling 1900 6763. You can then pay in person at any Hai Van service point. Please note that we cannot guarantee space for more than one piece of luggage per passenger, so please book early if you need to bring extra luggage.

Motorbikes and bicycles

Many of our routes allow you to bring a standard-size bicycle or motorbike. Please mention this when booking, or call our cargo team at least 6 hours before departure.

Hai Van: 1900 6763

Special luggage & cargo

For items larger than the luggage allowance, or if you would like to send goods, please visit one of our offices or call our hotline 1900 6763 for assistance.

Forgotten your luggage?

Please report your lost luggage here or call our customer service line on 1900 6763 for help. We will assist you as soon as we receive your request.

dich-vu/xe-lien-tinh/chon-cho-truoc.content:
Reserve your seat directly in the HAIVAN app

You can choose your seat while booking your ticket

After choosing your locations, you will be taken to the seat selection screen

Check the seat map and pick your preferred seat. Seats shaded dark grey cannot be reserved. Your seat will be highlighted in yellow

Continue to complete your booking. Your seat number will be shown on your ticket

On board, seat numbers are displayed along the aisle and on each seat

Or

You can also reserve a seat by calling our hotline 1900 6763

How do I find my seat on the bus?

On every trip, any seat or cabin on the vehicle can be reserved in advance.

If you have reserved a specific seat, you will find your seat number on your ticket. On vehicles with seat reservations, seat numbers are shown at eye level, and for cabin tickets the number is displayed on your cabin.

If you have not reserved a seat but your ticket shows an assigned seat, please sit in that seat.

If you have not reserved a seat and your ticket shows no assigned seat, the bus attendant will find a suitable seat for you. Priority seating is given to passengers with reduced mobility, older passengers and pregnant women.

Adding, changing and cancelling seat reservations

You can only choose a seat in advance while booking your ticket. After that, you cannot add or reserve a seat once your ticket is confirmed. If you would like to cancel or change your seat, please contact our customer service team.

dich-vu/xe-hop-dong/phuong-tien.content:
Hai Van currently operates nearly 250 vehicles with 7 to 45 seats, ready to meet every travel need. Alongside standard classes, we offer premium business-class vehicles developed by Hai Van itself, drawing on 25 years of experience serving premium travellers. With a large, high-quality fleet, we are confident we can serve even the most demanding customers.

Vehicle quality

Hai Van's fleet is standardised, serviced and maintained to stay in top condition. Checks are carried out regularly before every journey:

- Vehicles are serviced on a regular schedule, following the principle: "prevention is better than cure".

- Parts, especially safety-critical ones such as tyres and brakes, are replaced at mileage limits below their average lifespan to keep breakdowns to a minimum.

- Vehicles carry full safety equipment: seat belts, a first-aid kit, emergency hammers and fire extinguishers, all checked under a strict procedure every time the vehicle leaves the depot.

On-board safety systems

Hai Van already uses GPS and cameras with audio recording to monitor how drivers operate their vehicles and serve passengers.

In the near future, we will continue to improve and adopt new technologies such as:

- A two-way radio system that keeps every vehicle in constant contact with the operations centre, so drivers never need to use a mobile phone while driving, which is unsafe

- Breathalyser systems to check drivers' alcohol levels before leaving the station and before starting the vehicle.

- Monitoring of drivers' blood pressure and body temperature, with continuous health updates sent to the operations centre.

- Anti-drowsiness devices that track eye and head movements to alert drivers when they lose focus or enter stretches of road where lapses in concentration are common.

- Multilingual translation devices for drivers.

dich-vu/xe-hop-dong/an-toan-chat-luong.content:
Safety comes first

Hai Van complies with the law and puts passenger safety first, so we focus on continually improving the quality of our vehicles and services to meet our customers' diverse needs.

1. Legal compliance

Hai Van is a legal entity fully licensed to provide road passenger transport by car under the current laws of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam.

2. Vehicle safety

Every vehicle in service meets government regulations as well as Hai Van's own standards, ensuring the best possible safety and comfort for passengers. The technical condition of each vehicle is managed and monitored regularly. Servicing, repairs, technical issues and general vehicle information are all recorded in Hai Van's management system. With safety as our top priority, every vehicle goes through a daily inspection of safety conditions and amenity standards before it carries passengers, so you can enjoy a safe journey and the best possible service. We use IoT technology to warn of and prevent risks related to vehicle and system safety.

3. Our drivers

Every driver in service meets government regulations as well as Hai Van's own standards for safety, attentiveness, honesty, reliability, kindness and professionalism. All drivers are trained in driving and customer service, with a particular focus on safety as our top priority. Each month, drivers are scored and ranked based on ratings from passengers in the HAIVAN app and from Hai Van's customer care team.

Every day before starting work, each driver is checked for safe-driving conditions and health to make sure they are fit to drive. During the day, distance driven, speed, and working and rest hours are monitored through a centralised journey-tracking system with automatic alerts. IoT devices, such as anti-drowsiness systems and forward obstacle warnings, help warn of and prevent risks to drivers on the road. Drivers are also trained in customer service and communicating with passengers, and are certified in using the vehicle's technical and safety equipment.

4. Our commitment

We are fully committed to keeping our passengers safe. Every passenger is covered by travel insurance.
dich-vu/xe-hop-dong/an-toan-chat-luong.rm_desc: Hai Van complies with the law and puts passenger safety first, continually improving our vehicles and services to meet customers' diverse needs.

Welcome ("passenger" or "you") to our website (“Website"). Haivan.com ("haivan.com" or "we") - owned by Hai Van International Transport Joint Venture Company (“Hai Van company” or “Hai Van”) - is a service website catering to needs related to buying and selling coach tickets online, providing information on destinations, routes and providers for people who wish to travel, for coach operators wishing to sell tickets, and for passenger transport services through an online system.
References to the Website are deemed to include, but are not limited to, browsers, mobile applications and related derivatives.
By accessing, viewing and using the Website and/or by booking coach tickets through Haivan.com, you confirm that you agree to, and have read, understood and accepted to be bound by, the Website Operating Regulations and our terms of use and other policies and guidelines (published throughout the Website, including but not limited to: the Privacy Policy, Ticket Cancellation Policy, Refund Policy, Payment Guide, Dispute Resolution Mechanism, etc.). If you do not accept the terms set out below, please stop using the Website immediately.

Note: A seat that cannot be booked on Haivan.com does not necessarily mean that it has been sold. The coach operator may wish to hold that seat to handle special cases, may not offer it for sale online, or may withhold it for other reasons depending on the operator's business operations.

I. Terms used on the Haivan.com website and the services provided by Haivan.com

1. Terms

Fee schedule: means the fees and taxes as prescribed by the Carrier and the Authorities.

Route: Determined by the journey from the departure station to the arrival station for fixed-route coaches, and by the place of departure and place of arrival for chartered coaches and tourist coaches.

Coach station: means a facility forming part of the road transport infrastructure that serves vehicles picking up and dropping off passengers and provides services supporting passenger transport.

Stopover: means a scheduled stop on the passenger's journey, at a point between the point of departure and the destination.

Force majeure: Means an event that occurs objectively and is beyond the control of the parties, including but not limited to earthquakes, storms, floods, whirlwinds, tsunamis, landslides, fires, epidemics, war or the threat of war, riots, rebellion, strikes… and other unforeseeable disasters, or changes in policy or prohibitions by the competent authorities of Vietnam.

Conditions of carriage: means the requirements and contents that the coach operator and Haivan.com notify to passengers in relation to transport services, including the information shown on the ticket/journey confirmation and/or on the website and/or in the approved terms of use and/or other forms of publication.

Terms of use are the terms printed on the paper ticket or electronic ticket (itinerary/receipt or journey confirmation) referred to in these Operating Regulations and other notices.

Ticket: means a paper ticket issued by the carrier, an electronic ticket, or a journey confirmation provided to the passenger by Haivan.com or an authorised representative of Haivan.com, containing the passenger's name, booking code, journey information and other notices for the journey, sent by Haivan.com or an authorised representative of Haivan.com via the email address registered when using the service. A ticket here applies to fixed-route coaches. Where the carrier provides chartered coach or tourist coach services to the passenger, the “ticket” is understood to be the journey confirmation.

Fare: means the price and price surcharges published by the coach operators and/or the related conditions of carriage.

Carrier: includes fixed-route coaches, tourist coaches and chartered coaches

Passenger: means any person using the services on Haivan.com

Contract of carriage: means the agreements between the Carrier and the Passenger on the provision of services according to the Passenger's needs, evidenced by a ticket or another form of equivalent value to a ticket.

Booking: here applies to fixed-route coaches; it is understood as booking a tour for individual travellers in the case of tourist coaches, and as hiring a vehicle in the case of chartered coaches.

2. Tickets

The ticket is evidence confirming the contract of carriage between the Passenger and the Carrier.
The ticket is valid only for the Passenger whose name and journey are clearly stated on the ticket.
The Carrier provides transport services only to the Passenger named on the ticket.
Tickets may only be transferred, changed, refunded or cancelled in accordance with the terms of use, ticket conditions and fee schedule issued from time to time.

3. Ticket prices/Fares

The fare is the price published by the Carrier at the time the ticket is purchased.
The Passenger is responsible for paying all taxes, fees and charges; surcharges applicable to the Passenger are prescribed by the Authorities or competent organisations, or by Haivan.com or the Carriers. At the time of purchase, the Passenger will be informed of the taxes, fees, charges and surcharges in addition to the fare.
Haivan.com has the right to refuse to provide services, and the Carrier has the right to refuse to carry the Passenger and Baggage, if the applicable fare, taxes, fees, charges and surcharges have not been paid in full.
Fares, taxes, fees, charges and surcharges are paid in the currency specified on the system published by Haivan.com (VND by default), unless otherwise provided by law or otherwise decided by a competent state authority.

4. Stopovers

Stopovers may be accepted at agreed Stopover points in accordance with the requirements of the Authorities and the regulations of the Carrier.
Stopovers must be arranged in advance with the carrier and recorded on the Ticket.

5. Bookings

Seat reservation: Made on the system via the Website, Mobile App, Ticket Office, Agent or Hotline, after which the Passenger will be issued a booking code.

Booking confirmation: Made after the passenger completes payment on the system. The Passenger will be issued a Ticket with a confirmed booking code.

In some cases, where the ticket purchase specifies a time by which payment must be made before departure, the Passenger must complete payment before being issued a booking code and seat confirmation.
Changes to a reservation, including changes to the passenger's name, journey or departure time, are governed as follows:
You must pay any change fees and fare differences (if any) arising from changes to your ticket.
A change is only completed after payment of the change fee according to the Fee Schedule published by Haivan.com from time to time and the fare difference (if any). Haivan.com will update the changed information on the passenger's ticket.
The ticket must be paid in full before Haivan.com confirms the booking as successful. In any case where the ticket value has not been paid in full, Haivan.com has the right to cancel the booking.

Personal information: The Passenger accepts that the passenger's personal information is transferred to Haivan.com for the purpose of using the services provided by Haivan.com. For this purpose, the Passenger agrees to allow Haivan.com to store and use the personal information and to transfer that information to the carrier, authorised ticketing representatives, competent state authorities or other related service providers.

Haivan.com may use the personal information provided by the Passenger that Haivan.com obtains, including information about the Passenger's payment process and other utility services used, for the following purposes:

  • Reserving seats, making payments and purchasing tickets, providing transport services and related services and facilities;
  • Accounting, invoicing and auditing, and verifying credit cards or other payment cards;
  • Statistics and market analysis, and management of frequent customer programmes
  • Customer relations;
  • Direct marketing and market research;

Seats: As specified on your ticket. Passengers will be allocated seats when boarding; however, the coach operator has the right to change your seat at any time, even after the passenger has boarded, for reasons of safety, regulations of the Authorities, the Passenger's health or security.

II. Operating principles of Haivan.com

Organisations and individuals transacting on Haivan.com must respect the lawful rights and interests of the participating parties.
Electronic Tickets: The purchase and sale of services are made through a sales contract in the form of an electronic ticket, which Haivan.com provides to passengers who buy tickets through the Haivan.com system and which contains at least the following information: TICKET CODE, SEAT NUMBER. An Electronic Ticket is not valid as a VAT invoice. An Electronic Ticket may be in hard copy printed by the customer, or in the form of an SMS or email sent from Haivan.com, provided this does not contravene the law.
Passenger transport services transacted on Haivan.com must fully comply with the relevant legal regulations and must not fall within cases where business or advertising is prohibited under current law.
When members and/or partners access the Haivan.com website to purchase services, it is deemed that the members and/or partners have agreed to comply with and accept to be bound by the Haivan.com Operating Regulations.
Haivan.com does not own and/or operate coach services. Passengers can book coach tickets online from anywhere with an internet connection by choosing the coach operator, departure time and price, and have full discretion to choose and use the services of the coach operators on the Haivan.com website.
The content of this document, together with any amending, supplementing and replacing documents issued from time to time, forms an integral part of the sales agreement between Haivan.com and the ticket buyer. Any matters not clearly provided for in this document, or any conflict, shall be governed by the relevant current regulations and laws.

III. Transaction process

1. How to buy tickets and pay on Haivan.com

Haivan.com is built to provide maximum support to customers who wish to buy coach tickets online, providing full information on the coach operators and routes customers are interested in, and advising on a wide choice of passenger transport services to suit customers' needs. In addition, Haivan.com provides customers with a list of trusted ticket outlets with full information on prices and support policies for customers' reference.
When you wish to buy a ticket on Haivan.com, you should follow these steps:

  • Step 1: Search for the route you are interested in by selecting the departure point, destination and travel date on the Haivan.com website.
  • Step 2: Review the information published by Haivan.com, including the coach operator, price, departure time and seat type. Once you have made your choice, book the ticket by clicking the "Select seat" button, choose the Seat position, then select "Continue".
  • Step 3: Enter your contact details and passenger details (if buying a ticket on behalf of someone else), and choose a payment method (including online payment by domestic ATM card using the Banks' Internet Banking, Visa or MasterCard, e-wallet, or other methods). Then pay for the ticket as instructed.
  • Step 4: After receiving an SMS and a call from the customer care department confirming the booking, please check the information about your trip, the time and the ticket code shown in the My Trips section.
  • Step 5: Depending on the coach operator's operating model, customers may use the Haivan.com confirmation SMS or email to board the coach, or exchange it for a paper ticket at the ticket office of the coach operator whose service they have chosen.

2. Transaction safety assurance:

Haivan.com has established the following mechanism to ensure transaction safety:
Management of information on passenger transport service providers: When participating in selling tickets or passenger transport services on Haivan.com, coach operators must provide full information relating to their routes and accompanying services and must take full responsibility for this information.
The specific information includes: personal identification details for individuals, and information on legal status for organisations and legal entities. This information will be entered into Haivan.com's management database. At the same time, the accompanying services of coach operators posted on Haivan.com are services for which the coach operators have signed Cooperation Contracts with the Providers.
Haivan.com transaction control: Transactions between coach operators and customers will be entered into Haivan.com's management records and their status regularly updated.
Control through Passenger feedback: Customers have the right to submit complaints about coach operators to the Haivan.com Management Board. Upon receiving such feedback, Haivan.com will verify the information. Where the Customer's report is found to be accurate, Haivan.com will take timely remedial measures depending on the severity.

3. Promotions and Discounts:

A maximum of 01 discount/promotion programme or 01 discount/promotion code may be applied to a single booking payment
Any promotion offered by Haivan.com and/or Haivan.com's partners may be changed without prior notice
Each promotion may have its own terms of use; passengers are responsible for consulting the page offering the promotion.

4. Complaint handling:

In the event of a complaint, the passenger must give notice within 7 days of the departure date.
Complaints about coach operators may be sent to the Haivan.com Management Board using the contact details published on the website. Upon receiving such feedback, Haivan.com will verify the information and, where the report is found to be accurate, will take timely remedial measures depending on the severity.
Customers should regularly read and comply with the Policies and Regulations published in the Haivan.com Trading Platform Management Regulations in order to understand and comply with the Policies and Regulations in force at that time.

5. Rights and obligations of Haivan.com:

Rights of Haivan.com:

Haivan.com has the right to check, update and edit information relating to coach operators, routes and other information upon receiving information from the coach operator or upon discovering new information that may affect customers or the reputation of Haivan.com.
To refuse, suspend or terminate the provision of information about coach operators, routes and other related information where there are grounds to prove that the information provided by the coach operators to Haivan.com is inaccurate, incomplete, or violates the law, ethics or the fine customs and traditions of Vietnam.
Haivan.com retains the copyright to use the services and content on Haivan.com in accordance with the law on intellectual property protection in Vietnam. "Haivan.com" and all icons, logos and content in the various languages are the property of Haivan.com. Any unlawful copying, use or dissemination of the above proprietary rights is strictly prohibited.

The responsibilities of Haivan.com include:

Publishing and updating the information provided by coach operators in order to sell tickets or provide customer services through the Haivan.com website
Establishing a mechanism for providing information and booking on Haivan.com that allows customers using Haivan.com to follow the correct online procedure for booking, buying and cancelling tickets via the website
Actively supporting state management authorities in investigating unlawful business conduct; providing documents such as registration information and transaction data history of parties engaged in unlawful conduct on Haivan.com
Where a customer buys a ticket and a dispute arises with the coach operator or the customer's lawful interests are harmed, Haivan.com will provide the customer with information about the coach operator at the request of a competent authority, and will actively support customers in protecting their lawful rights and interests
Maintaining the normal operation of Haivan.com and remedying incidents that affect the operation of Haivan.com. In the event of force majeure, including but not limited to: natural disasters, fires, social unrest or decisions of the competent authorities, Haivan.com shall not bear joint liability

The responsibilities of Haivan.com do not include:

  • Any inaccurate or incomplete data provided by the customer when booking.
  • The passenger arriving late at the point of departure.
  • Being unable to contact the passenger by phone, or the coach operator not calling the passenger at the point of departure and leaving without picking up the passenger.
  • The passenger not waiting at the correct point of departure.
  • The coach operator arranging a shuttle vehicle to pick up passengers at the point of departure, with passengers then boarding a main coach at another location.
  • Inaccurate bookings made by an agent; passengers should contact the agent directly.
  • The type of vehicle used by the coach operator to transfer passengers.

6. Rights and obligations of coach operators:

In order to protect the interests of coach operators, the Haivan.com Management Board provides coach operators with important information they need to know before Haivan.com begins selling the coach operator's tickets.
To be informed of customer feedback on the quality of the services the coach operator provides to customers, with the consent of the Haivan.com Management Board
The coach operator must take full responsibility for the quality of the services posted on Haivan.com. In all cases, the coach operator is responsible for resolving all customer complaints relating to the quality of the services provided.
The coach operator is obliged to provide its services posted on Haivan.com once customers have purchased them online. Where the coach operator fails to provide the services, or fails to provide them as described in the listing, without promptly notifying the Haivan.com Management Board of the reason, the Haivan.com Management Board is responsible for contacting the coach operator to resolve the matter and for requiring the coach operator to compensate the customer and Haivan.com for the damage caused by the coach operator.
All transaction information is kept confidential and shall not be transferred to any third party, except where its disclosure is required by a Law Enforcement Authority.

7. Rights and obligations of passengers buying tickets:

Haivan.com will not charge any additional surcharges relating to the service and payment gateway other than those clearly stated on the booking details page
A booking is deemed confirmed if the booking confirmation page is displayed to the passenger, even if the passenger does not receive the SMS or Email for any reason
If you do not receive the confirmation or cancellation SMS/Email for any reason, you may contact us for assistance in having it resent. Information sent via SMS / Email may not be delivered or may arrive late for various reasons beyond Haivan.com's control
Passengers must arrive 30 minutes (60 minutes on public holidays and Tet) before the scheduled departure time, or earlier depending on the coach operator's regulations
The arrival and departure times stated on the ticket are estimates only, meaning that trips may be delayed. On the day of travel, passengers should contact the operator using the contact details printed on the ticket to confirm the departure location and time
At the time of boarding, passengers will be required to provide the following information; otherwise, they may be refused boarding:

  • The ticket SMS or Email containing the ticket information (accepted by most coach operators)
  • Some coach operators do not accept electronic ticket formats (details of these operators are given in the booking section of Haivan.com); passengers should print the ticket information on paper and bring it with them
  • National ID card (or other photo identification such as a passport, driving licence…)

By booking on Haivan.com, the passenger agrees to allow Haivan.com to call, email, send SMS messages or send notifications in order to provide or obtain information relating to the passenger's booking
In the event that there is no seat for the passenger even though the seat has been confirmed, for any reason (change to the departure schedule, trip cancellation, force majeure, operational issues, …), the passenger has the right to choose one of the following options:

  • We arrange for the passenger to travel on the next available trip with free seats at no extra charge.
  • A refund of the ticket price to the passenger for the trip on which the passenger was refused carriage.

When a passenger reserves a seat on Haivan.com, Haivan.com will endeavour to provide the seat position requested by the passenger. However, Haivan.com does not guarantee any particular position on the coach. Haivan.com reserves the right to reassign the passenger's seat on the coach for reasons of operations, security, safety, health, or at the request of a competent authority.
Customers should regularly read and comply with the Policies and Regulations of the Operating Regulations published on Haivan.com in order to understand and comply with the Policies and Regulations in force at that time.

Passenger support information:

Haivan.com website Management Board: Hai Van International Transport Joint Venture Company.
Address: 5th Floor, 125 Hoang Ngan Building, Yen Hoa Ward, Hanoi
Phone: 1900 6763
Email: info@haivan.com

8. Management of harmful information:

Coach operators must provide complete and accurate information to Haivan.com when listing tickets for sale on Haivan.com, particularly information on prices and service quality. Any amended, supplemented or replaced information must be promptly notified to the Trading Platform Management Board for updating on the Website.
Users must not exploit the services of Haivan.com for illegal, unreasonable or fraudulent purposes, threats, unlawful information probing, sabotage, or the creation and distribution of viruses that damage the system, configuration or information transmission of Haivan.com. In the event of a violation, the user concerned shall be held responsible for their actions before the law.
Users must not alter, modify, combine, copy, disseminate, distribute, provide or create similar tools of the services provided by Haivan.com for a third party without the consent of Haivan.com under these Regulations.
Users must not propagate or disseminate information detrimental to the reputation of Haivan.com or the coach operators in any form, such as providing harmful, non-objective or untruthful information about Haivan.com and the coach operators.

9. Ticket cancellation policy:

To cancel a ticket, passengers may:

Call 1900 6763 from the phone number used to make the booking, and provide the ticket code together with other information as instructed by the Haivan.com hotline operator.
The cancellation deadline depends on the time the coach departs from the start of the route and does not depend on the time the passenger boards. Example: If the coach departs at 7:00 and the passenger boards at 12:00, the cancellation deadline is calculated from 7:00, not 12:00.

Cancellation policy for tickets booked through Haivan.com:

Cancellation policies vary by coach operator. To find out the cancellation policy, please see the "Cancellation policy" section when you select a coach operator on Haivan.com. If the ticket has been paid for, the cancellation policy will be sent with the confirmation email. For further information on the cancellation policy, please contact the Haivan.com Customer Care department by email or via the hotline.
The Cancellation Policy does not include the bank transfer fee for returning money to you.
Refund amount = Total amount paid – Cancellation fee – Transfer fee (if any).
The cancellation fee is applied to the original ticket price, not to the ticket price after discounts. The cancellation penalty is deducted from the ticket amount paid or discounted, and the remaining amount will be refunded.

10. Refund policy:

Ticket refunds in cases of cancellation are transferred to the bank account, debit card, credit card or wallet account that the passenger used when booking.
All refunds are processed automatically upon cancellation. The passenger's bank will normally need 7 - 10 working days to credit this amount to the account or card
If the refunded amount has not been credited to the passenger's account within 10 working days, please email info@haivan.com with the ticket details. We will provide you with the necessary assistance to have the refunded amount credited to the passenger's account or card
No refund will be made if the passenger is not present at the point of departure on time
Transaction fees or ticket delivery fees will not be refunded where the customer requests the cancellation themselves
Where a coach operator cancels a trip or service, Haivan.com will endeavour to help passengers find an alternative service depending on the options available. If no alternative service is available, Haivan.com's liability to the passenger shall be limited to refunding the amount the passenger paid for the ticket
Amenities such as TV, air conditioning, water or any other services mentioned on Haivan.com are provided to give passengers fuller information before making a decision. Any refund requests or complaints arising from the absence of these amenities must be resolved directly with the coach operator.

11. Privacy policy

Haivan.com values its relationships with customers and website users. We strive to provide information responsibly and to ensure the system operates accurately. We respect passengers' privacy and want to make accessing our website comfortable and convenient.
When you access this website, certain information about you, such as your IP address, the pages you select on the website, the systems and programs used and the time spent, together with other similar information, may be stored on our servers or on third-party servers such as Google Analytics. Such information may not specifically identify you. We may use this information to analyse website traffic or for other purposes we consider appropriate.
If you provide personally identifiable information such as your name, address and other information to us, this information may be used for statistical and/or other purposes. Any personally identifiable information you provide when booking tickets with Haivan.com will only be disclosed to the providers/coach operators involved in your booking. We will not disclose, sell, share or in any other way reveal your information to a third party.
Haivan.com may use your personal contact information such as your email and mobile phone number to contact you and to notify you of information about your trip or promotions offered by Haivan.com or our partners.
We want you to feel confident about using Haivan.com to plan and buy coach tickets, so we are committed to protecting the information we collect. While no website can guarantee complete security, we have implemented appropriate security procedures to protect the personal information you provide to us. To prevent unauthorised access, maintain data accuracy and ensure the correct use of information, we will use reasonable Internet security methods and technologies.
This policy is not a legally binding contract, but we undertake to make every effort to comply with it in order to protect your personal information when you use the services we provide.
The privacy policy may change over time or according to actual circumstances. We reserve the right to amend this policy at any time without prior notice.

12. Limitation of liability in the event of technical errors on the trading platform

When carrying out transactions on the Platform, customers must strictly follow the instructed procedures.
The Haivan.com Management Board undertakes to provide the best quality of service to customers participating in transactions. Where technical errors, software errors or other objective errors prevent customers from participating in transactions, customers should notify the Haivan.com Management Board at the email address: info@haivan.com or Phone: 1900 6763. Haivan.com will fix the error as soon as possible to assist customers.
The Haivan.com Management Board shall not be responsible for resolving cases where customers' notifications do not reach the Management Board due to technical errors, transmission errors, software errors or other errors not caused by the Management Board.

13. Unsuccessful transactions:

An online payment transaction may fail for various reasons, and the passenger's account or card may be debited without a corresponding ticket being issued. If money has been deducted from your account or card, please contact the Haivan.com customer care hotline or contact your bank or e-wallet service provider directly to reconfirm the failed transaction before making a new transaction or booking.
Transactions in such cases will be refunded to the customer in accordance with the refund policy set out in the Haivan.com Regulations

14. Dispute and complaint resolution mechanism

Disputes over electronic tickets between customers and passenger transport service providers.
If a dispute arises over the confirmation of an electronic ticket between a customer and a trader for the provision of services, Haivan.com will appoint a representative to take part in the dispute resolution process, by providing the relevant stored information, records or documents as to whether or not the customer purchased the trader's coach ticket through the Haivan.com website, in order to resolve the dispute.
If there are grounds to confirm that the coach ticket held by the customer was sold by Haivan.com and matches the route, time, location and other relevant information, the service-providing trader has no right to reject it and must provide the service to the customer as committed. If the trader does not provide the service to the customer, Haivan.com will take part in resolving the matter by negotiating with the service-providing trader so that the service is provided to the customer. If the parties cannot reach a common agreement and the customer is still not provided with the service, Haivan.com undertakes to refund an amount equal to the value of the ticket the customer paid. The trader shall be responsible to Haivan.com for failing to provide the service as committed between the parties.
If the customer suffers damage due to the passenger transport trader's failure to provide the service, the parties, including the customer, Haivan.com and the passenger transport service trader, will resolve the matter through agreement, in a spirit of cooperation and equality, ensuring the legitimate interests of the customer. If no common agreement can be reached, the matter will be referred to the competent authority for resolution.
If the trader has evidence proving that the disputed coach ticket is incorrect or invalid, it may refuse to provide the service to the customer, and Haivan.com is responsible for resolving the issue of the authenticity of the disputed coach ticket with the customer.
The parties must properly fulfil their responsibilities, rights and obligations during the dispute resolution process. If damage occurs, the parties will negotiate together in a spirit of cooperation to find the most reasonable solution. If a common will cannot be reached during the dispute resolution process, the dispute will be referred to the competent authority for resolution.

Disputes over service quality

Where a dispute arises during or after the trader provides services to the customer, the customer may send a complaint directly to the Haivan.com customer support department. Upon receiving a passenger's complaint, the Haivan.com customer support department will immediately forward it to the Coach Operator by the fastest means and request its resolution.
On receiving a complaint from a customer or feedback from Haivan.com about service quality and other related disputes during or after the provision of services, the passenger transport service trader must promptly handle and resolve it and take urgent measures where necessary to ensure that minimal damage is caused to the customer.

For customers using services on Haivan.com

Customers should regularly read and comply with the Policies and Regulations published on Haivan.com in order to understand and comply with the Policies and Regulations in force at that time.
Haivan.com will make every reasonable effort to resolve complaints from customers using services on the Haivan.com Website. If such efforts fail, the customer must agree that any complaint or dispute of the customer against the Haivan.com Website or a trader shall be resolved in accordance with the laws of Vietnam, and that the total liability of the Haivan.com Website to each customer shall not exceed the amount the Haivan.com Website received from that customer in respect of the matter to which the customer's complaint relates.

Disputes arising during transactions:

When buying coach tickets on the Haivan.com website, if any problem arises during booking, ticket information confirmation or payment, the customer should contact the Haivan.com customer support department directly to have it resolved quickly and promptly.
Where technical errors, software errors or other objective errors prevent customers from participating in transactions, customers should notify Haivan.com at the email address: info@haivan.com or Phone: 1900 6763. We will fix the error as soon as possible to enable customers to transact on Haivan.com.

Other disputes during transactions

When any other dispute arises during transactions on the Haivan.com website, Haivan.com and the relevant parties, such as the passenger transport service trader, the bank providing payment services and the customer using the services, will appoint representatives to take part in the resolution process.

15. Applicable terms:

All disputes arising during transactions on Haivan.com between coach operators and passengers will be resolved by negotiation between the parties; if they cannot be resolved by the parties themselves, either party has the right to refer the matter to the Competent Authority for resolution in accordance with the law

HAIVAN is always ready to receive and handle customer complaints related to transactions made on Haivan.com.

If any complaint or dispute arises in connection with transport services booked through HAIVAN, customers are kindly asked to notify us as soon as possible. HAIVAN and the Service Provider undertake to engage with and support customers in resolving all such complaints and disputes objectively, on the basis of the agreement and the law. We always favour conciliation and negotiation between the parties in order to maintain good relations and Customers' trust in the services on Haivan.com


1. Complaint channels:

Customers with any complaint about Services purchased at HAIVAN should proceed as follows:
Option 1: Send an email to info@haivan.com
Option 2: Call our support hotline: 1900 6763
Option 3: Complain directly to the service provider. In this case, the Service Provider and/or the Customer have the right to ask HAIVAN to help resolve issues arising from the transaction made on the website, and the Service Provider is responsible for resolving the complaint and responding to the Buyer promptly.


2. The procedure for receiving and handling complaints and disputes is as follows:

Step 1: The customer contacts HAIVAN through the complaint channels listed in Option 1 and Option 2 of Section 1.
Step 2: HAIVAN's Customer Care department receives the customer's complaint. Depending on the nature and severity of the complaint, HAIVAN will follow specific procedures to help the customer resolve the dispute within no more than seven (7) working days of receiving the complaint.
Step 3: HAIVAN has the right to ask the customer to provide information and evidence relating to the transaction in order to verify and clarify the matter and determine an appropriate resolution.
Step 4: All disputes arising will preferably be resolved through discussion and negotiation.

  • Where a dispute arises from a transaction and the fault lies with the Service Provider, HAIVAN will apply appropriate measures depending on the seriousness of the violation. In addition, the Service Provider must compensate and reimburse the Customer satisfactorily on the basis of negotiation.
  • If the complainant does not agree with the Service Provider's resolution, HAIVAN will be responsible for leading negotiation and conciliation between the parties to reach a final solution;
  • If negotiation fails within 30 days, the parties may bring the dispute before a competent People's Court. HAIVAN will provide relevant information about the Customer and the Provider if required by law.

chinh-sach/bao-mat-thanh-toan.content:
Purpose

The payment system on Haivan.com (“HAIVAN”) is connected to Payment Gateway Partners that are legally licensed to operate in Vietnam, such as VNPay, Cybersource, Payoo, … Accordingly, HAIVAN's payment security standards comply with the security standards of these Payment Gateway Partners, organisations whose security has been assessed and whose operations have been officially licensed by the State Bank of Vietnam.


Specific provisions

This payment security policy ensures compliance with the security standards of the Payment Gateway Partners, including:

  • The SSL (Secure Sockets Layer) standard for securing data on the internet.
  • Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) certification provided by Trustwave.
  • SHA 256-bit encryption.
  • One-time passwords (OTP) sent by SMS to ensure that account access is authenticated, or 3D Secure for Visa and MasterCard cards (security certified by Visa and MasterCard).
  • The information security principles and regulations of the banking and finance sector as prescribed by the State Bank of Vietnam.

HAIVAN's payment transaction security policy applies to Customers as follows:

  • HAIVAN offers a token storage feature – storing only the encrypted string provided to HAIVAN by the Payment Gateway Partner. HAIVAN does not directly store customers' card information. The security of Customers' payment card information is handled by the licensed Payment Gateway Partner.
  • For international cards: Customers' payment card information that could be used to initiate a transaction is not stored on HAIVAN's systems. The Payment Gateway Partner stores and secures it.
  • For domestic cards (internet banking): HAIVAN only stores the order code, transaction code and bank name.

HAIVAN is committed to strictly implementing all necessary security measures for every payment made on Haivan.com.

ho-tro/huong-dan-thanh-toan.content:
1. Go to the Haivan.com homepage

2. Select the type of service you want to use

3. Select your departure point, destination, travel date and number of passengers, then click “Search”

4. A list of tickets for matching trips appears. Choose the trip you want and click the arrow to view its details

5. Review the services and choose your seats on the trip details page

After choosing your seats, click “Continue” to buy your ticket

6. If this is your first purchase, the “Log in” screen will appear. To log in:

- Enter your phone number
- Confirm: “I'm not a robot”
- Enter the OTP sent to your phone

7. Enter your details and confirm your booking

Enter your full name and contact phone number
If you need a shuttle transfer, enter the transfer address and the corresponding fields
If you have any special requests, enter them in the “Notes” field to let the coach operator know
Once you have confirmed that your booking details are correct, click “Confirm booking”

8. Payment methods

Haivan.com currently offers customers 4 payment options:
Pay by domestic ATM card / VNPayQR
Pay by international card
Pay by bank transfer
Pay directly at the coach operator's office

8.1 Pay by domestic ATM card / VNPayQR

To pay by domestic ATM card / VNPayQR, please select the bank you want to use from the banks supported by VNPay.
Then enter your payment details as instructed. After confirming the details, click “Pay” to complete.

For Hai Van, sustainable development means a harmonious balance of three elements: Economic development, Community support and Environmental protection.

Action programmes

AreaAction programmeResults achieved
Economy- Ensure solid growth across financial indicators.
- Continuously research and develop new products of ever-higher quality.
- Bring high-quality, modern products to people in many provinces and cities nationwide, giving them access to attentive, caring passenger transport and helping improve quality of life and the quality of transport in Vietnam.		- Revenue and profit: $30M (2019) - Hai Van currently has 5 product lines and 250 vehicles in operation, and is a pioneer in passenger transport in Vietnam.

For Hai Van, stakeholders are those who influence, or are influenced to some degree by, Hai Van's business activities, including: customers; employees; the community; the Government and its agencies; and the press and media. Information and feedback from stakeholders are among the key factors shaping how the Company is managed and operated, and its long-term development.

For our customers

Hai Van is today one of the most trusted passenger transport brands. Guided by its commitment to attentive and caring road transport, Hai Van places great importance on investing in research and developing distinctive product lines with outstanding service quality, giving people in Vietnam access to advanced services on a par with any country in the world. Through its sales team, customer care centre and channels such as Facebook, the website and community groups, the Company engages regularly with customers to understand their needs more deeply and serve them more attentively. Events such as exhibitions, fairs, seminars and product launches give the Company the chance to meet potential customers in person and understand them better, helping Hai Van build close connections and become a trusted travel companion for every customer, with dedication and ever-improving capability. Over the years, Hai Van's achievements have been recognised through a series of awards from organisations in Vietnam and abroad.

For our employees

People are a key contributor to the Company's growth. Hai Van is a workplace many aspire to, thanks to its efforts to give every employee the best conditions to develop their abilities, grow personally and achieve outstanding success, while safeguarding their material and personal well-being. The Company proactively communicates its strategic direction and operating plans so that every employee clearly understands their position and role within the shared direction; it also regularly exchanges views, listens to feedback, answers questions and meets employees' legitimate aspirations. The engagement, trust and wholehearted commitment of our employees are the foundation for Hai Van's sustainable development

For the Government, ministries and agencies

Hai Van is a pioneer in road passenger transport and has always recognised its role and responsibility to contribute fully to the development of Vietnam's transport sector. The Company keeps up to date with global transport trends, proactively researches and develops, and puts forward proposals suited to local conditions, helping modernise and raise the quality of transport services. Hai Van also proposes initiatives that help the authorities strengthen management and supervision, such as applying modern technology systems to management, operations and automatic real-time reporting, reducing the risk of errors from manual management and supporting accurate, timely decisions in critical situations. In addition, Hai Van has pioneered proposals for pilot passenger services on a number of routes, such as Tan Son Nhat Airport – Vung Tau, giving people convenient access to high-quality services, helping modernise and professionalise airport transfer services, and enhancing the standing and image of Tan Son Nhat Airport in the eyes of international visitors.

For the community

Hai Van deeply wishes that everyone could have the chance to experience high-quality transport. With this in mind, every year and on suitable occasions, Hai Van gives the community opportunities to use high-quality transport services, such as free trips home for Tet for people working or studying far from home, including industrial park workers and students. Hundreds of trips and many thousands of tickets have been donated by Hai Van to the community in this spirit.

Mr Tran Van Hung (Thai Binh) was one of the passengers on a free trip home for Tet donated by Hai Van. Explaining why he was heading home so late, he said work had kept him so busy that he could only leave at noon that day, just in time for the last coach. When he learned that Hai Van was giving him a free ticket, along with a lucky 100,000 VND New Year gift, he was deeply grateful and moved. It felt like a word of encouragement and moral support for people like him who have to go home late, since almost everyone travelling home at that hour does so because of work or personal reasons. “Everyone feels a little sad when they can't go home early to celebrate Tet with their family, but having a free trip made me happier. More importantly, this transport company has built a culture of service and gives passengers encouragement when they need it,” Mr Hung shared.

Another typical example is when Hai Van supported a group of 6 passengers travelling from Vung Tau to Ho Chi Minh City to catch a flight to Phu Quoc. Although they left Vung Tau on time, a traffic incident caused congestion along the entire route and the group missed their flight. Immediately, living up to its commitment to being Attentive and Caring, Hai Van reimbursed 100% of the cost of rebooking all 6 passengers onto another flight, and also gave them free return tickets from Tan Son Nhat Airport to Vung Tau. The customers rated the service very highly and were extremely satisfied.

Hai Van always strives to deliver the greatest and most lasting benefits to its stakeholders, for the sustainable development of customers, employees, the community and the nation.

chung-toi/an-toan-chat-luong.content:
Safety is our top priority

HAIVAN complies with the law and puts the safety of its customers first, which is why we always focus on continuously improving the quality of our vehicles and services to meet our customers' diverse needs.

1. Legal compliance

HAIVAN is a legal entity holding all the correct and complete licences for road passenger transport by car in accordance with the current laws of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam.

2. Vehicle safety

Vehicles in commercial operation fully meet all State legal requirements as well as Hai Van's own standards, to ensure the best safety and comfort for customers. Their technical condition is managed and monitored regularly. All maintenance, repairs, technical issues and general vehicle information are recorded in Hai Van's management system. With safety as our number one goal, every vehicle goes through an inspection process each day before serving customers, confirming that all safety conditions and amenity standards are met, so that customers enjoy the safest journey and the best service experience. We use IoT to warn of and prevent risks related to vehicle and system safety.

3. Our drivers

Drivers in commercial operation fully meet all State legal requirements as well as Hai Van's own standards, ensuring they are safe, attentive, honest, reliable, caring and professional. All drivers are trained in driving skills, customer service and, above all, the goal of safety first, and are scored and ranked every month based on ratings from customers who used the service on the HAIVAN app and from the Hai Van Customer Care team.

Every day, before starting work, every driver is checked for safe-driving conditions and health to ensure they are fit for duty. During the working day, drivers' distance, operating speed, and working and rest hours are monitored through a centralised journey-monitoring system with automatic alerts. IoT is used to warn of and prevent risks that could compromise driver safety on the road, for example through anti-drowsiness devices and forward obstacle warnings. Drivers are also trained in customer service and communication with passengers, and are trained and certified to use the technical and safety equipment on board proficiently.

4. Assurance policy

We are committed to ensuring the absolute safety of our passengers. All passengers are covered by travel insurance

chung-toi/gioi-thieu.content:
Why choose Hai Van

Founded in 1994, after more than three decades Hai Van has become one of the leading passenger transport companies in Vietnam's premium segment, with more than 1,000 employees. Hai Van is headquartered in Hanoi and has a service network spanning the whole country. With our mission of providing premium, caring and reliable transport services to every customer, we not only keep up with the latest transport trends around the world to create unique products and services, but also continually invest in research and understanding so we can best meet every need of every customer.

For Hai Van, happiness means serving customers perfectly, anytime, anywhere, whatever they need. We invite you to experience Hai Van's special service!

Our services

Long-distance coaches

Hai Van is committed to providing premium coach services at reasonable prices so that every customer can enjoy them. We are the only coach company in Vietnam to offer customers a luxurious waiting lounge with a full range of services like an airline business lounge, from seating and a self-service snack selection to television and Wi-Fi. Hai Van's pride also lies in the very special seats on our Royal coach line, researched and designed to deliver maximum comfort and relaxation, upholstered in premium leather usually found only in supercars. In this segment, Hai Van is No. 1 in intercity transport market share in northern Vietnam, having once held around 70% of the Lao Cai – Sapa route; and No. 1 in fleet size and service frequency in the north, with more than 100 vehicles operating across 9 northern provinces and 150 departures a day. Hai Van carries up to 2 million passengers a year.

Vehicle hire

For the trip you want, you can book a vehicle with a driver in advance for journeys within a city or between cities. We offer flexible services with many options, from hourly bookings to bookings of several months. Our fleet is highly diverse, from small 7-seat cars to large 45-seat coaches, and we regularly offer special deals for group travel to cut costs and make things more convenient for you. Let Hai Van serve you in the most attentive and caring way!

Airport transfers

With Vietnam's air travel market growing at double-digit rates, Hai Van decided to enter the market for transfers from airports to major city centres. HAIVAN is currently the FIRST and ONLY private company licensed by the government to pilot this service at all major airports in Vietnam. The service was first launched in April 2019 at Tan Son Nhat Airport, Ho Chi Minh City, and was set to reach Noi Bai Airport, Hanoi in June 2020 and airports across the country by 2022

Core values

Hai Van is built on three core values: people, technology and vehicles.

People

Drawing on more than 30 years of experience, Hai Van has developed a set of training standards to equip drivers with the most essential knowledge and a deep understanding of customers so they can serve them better. We study every detail of the customer experience throughout the journey to keep improving our service over time and maintain our leading position.

Technology

Hai Van recognises that improving operating processes and service quality is vital, so we focus on investing in and applying technology in all our activities to manage efficiently and keep bringing customers convenient experiences, such as easy booking through the app, loyalty customer data management, and earning and redeeming reward points...

Vehicles

Hai Van focuses on maintaining a modern fleet that meets transport quality standards by continuing to upgrade and improve the following three areas:

- Entertainment systems to enhance the customer experience.

- Vehicle safety monitoring systems to improve oversight and help drivers act quickly in an emergency.

- Driver safety monitoring systems to track drivers' health

These areas reflect our commitment to giving customers comfort, convenience and, most importantly, safety.
